target_segment: SMB (small and medium-sized enterprises, freelancers, mid-size businesses)
target_vertical: Multi-channel e-commerce retailers, B2B wholesalers/distributors, light manufacturers (assembly/disassembly), DTC brands with traceability needs (food, cosmetics, pharma)
pricing_model: Tiered subscription based on GMV/order volume bands, with per-user and per-warehouse limits at lower tiers and unlimited at higher tiers. Add-ons: $20/month per e-commerce integration, $20/month for API access, $49/month for B2B e-commerce platform.
starting_price_usd: $79/month (Starter) per Capterra/GetApp; vendor pricing page references a Starter at ~$99/month for under $200K GMV [uncertain - pricing varies by source/date]
free_trial_or_freemium: 14-day fully-featured free trial, no credit card required; no permanent freemium tier
shopify_install_count: Approximately 60 reviews on Shopify App Store
shopify_plus_partner_status: [uncertain] - not confirmed as listed Shopify Plus Certified App Partner
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional: products/variants/inventory pushed from Qoblex to Shopify; orders/customers pulled from Shopify into Qoblex; fulfillment updates pushed back to Shopify
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory levels, orders, customers, fulfillments/shipments, refunds/returns; bundle/kit components decrement parent stock live on Shopify
shopify_service_item_support: [uncertain] - no documented support for non-physical service items syncing as Shopify products
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes - multiple Shopify stores can be connected (each counted as an e-commerce integration add-on)
shopify_pos_support: Inventory availability auto-syncs across POS locations and webshop; depth beyond inventory sync (e.g. POS sales as orders) [uncertain]
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: Qoblex offers its own private B2B e-commerce portal (separate $49/month add-on) rather than native handling of Shopify B2B (Plus) catalogs/company locations [uncertain - direct Shopify B2B catalog API support]
shopify_markets_support: [uncertain] - no documented native Shopify Markets (multi-market pricing/duties) awareness
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: [uncertain] - no documented generic Shopify metafield to Qoblex custom-field mapping
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Variants mapped by SKU/barcode; rich product attributes including SKU, barcode, supplier code, variants and images supported
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Near-real-time; sync runs every ~5 minutes and is also triggered on order changes/updates
shopify_known_limitations: Reports of occasional bugs where fulfilled orders did not clear and tied up allocated inventory; non-Plus account limitations for native Shopify B2B not handled (Qoblex uses its own B2B portal instead).
etsy_supported: [uncertain] - no direct native Etsy integration documented; Qoblex content encourages selling on Etsy/eBay/Amazon as complementary channels but direct Etsy connector not confirmed
amazon_marketplaces: [uncertain] - specific marketplace coverage (US/UK/EU/AU/JP/etc.) not publicly enumerated
amazon_seller_types: [uncertain] - FBA vs FBM vs Vendor Central scope not publicly documented
amazon_synced_entities: Inventory and orders sync at minimum; full entity coverage (settlements, returns, customer messaging) [uncertain]
amazon_settlement_report_handling: [uncertain] - no documented settlement-report posting workflow to Xero/QBO
amazon_multi_account_support: Each Amazon connection counted as a separate e-commerce integration add-on ($20/month each), suggesting multiple accounts supported [uncertain - explicit confirmation]
amazon_known_limitations: [uncertain] - depth of Amazon integration is less documented than Shopify; positioned as 'and more' rather than a primary channel
xero_app_store_certified: Yes - listed on Xero App Store (apps.xero.com/us/app/qoblex)
xero_app_awards_recognition: Xero Global App Awards 2025 Finalist - Small Business App of the Year (Canada, South Africa, and Asia regions)
xero_app_store_rating: [uncertain] - specific star rating and review count on Xero App Store not captured
xero_synced_entities: Invoices (from sale orders), bills (from purchase orders), payments, credit notes (from refunds/returns), COGS journals, stock-on-hand adjustments, manufacturing costs, inventory adjustments, contacts/customers
xero_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order - sale orders sync as individual Xero invoices; purchase orders sync as individual Xero bills; supports batch syncing of invoices/payments/credit notes
xero_cogs_journal_method: perpetual_per_movement - COGS and stock-on-hand ledgers updated with each refund/adjustment; moving average cost method used for valuation; landed costs included in inventory cost
xero_multi_currency: Yes - multi-currency invoice/bill posting supported (multi-currency platform with 200 currencies)
xero_tracking_category_mapping: Yes - smart sync rules let users route invoice/credit-note line items and bill line items to different Xero ledger accounts and/or Xero tracking categories; per-channel and per-item routing supported
xero_tax_handling: Tax codes mapped via sync rules to Xero ledger accounts; specific GST/VAT scheme handling [uncertain in detail]
xero_known_limitations: [uncertain] - no major publicly reported limitations; one Capterra reviewer noted minor sync bugs around fulfilled orders
qb_online_supported: Yes - native integration; listed on Intuit App Store
qb_desktop_supported: [uncertain] - QuickBooks Online is the documented channel; Desktop not confirmed
qb_app_store_rating: [uncertain] - specific Intuit App Store star rating and review count not captured
qb_synced_entities: Invoices (from sale orders), bills (from purchase orders), payments, credit notes (from refunds), customers, vendors, COGS adjustments, stock-on-hand adjustments
qb_accounting_sync_mode: invoice_per_order - sale orders sync as QBO invoices; PO syncs as QBO bills
qb_cogs_journal_method: perpetual_per_movement - SOH and COGS ledgers updated with each refund/adjustment; landed-cost-inclusive moving average valuation
qb_multi_currency: [uncertain] - presumed yes given multi-currency platform but explicit QBO multi-currency posting not confirmed
qb_class_location_mapping: Yes - smart sync rules route line items to different QBO ledger accounts and/or tracking categories (Class/Location equivalent)
other_ecom_channels: Native: Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon. Also referenced as complementary channels for marketing/selling: eBay, Etsy (depth of direct integration unclear). Custom storefronts and other channels reachable via public API. BigCommerce, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Wix, Squarespace, Faire, Square, Magento - [uncertain] not confirmed as native connectors.
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes - bundles automatically decrement component stock; bundle component stock counts sync live to Shopify so both the bundle and underlying components reflect accurate availability
other_accounting_integrations: Xero and QuickBooks Online are the two documented native accounting integrations. Other accounting platforms (Sage, MYOB, Zoho Books, FreshBooks, NetSuite, Wave) not listed as native; would require custom integration via the public API.
bom_support: Yes - dedicated Bill of Materials module with components, quantities, and cost roll-up
multi_level_bom: Yes - manufacturing module supports BOM variants and component management; nested/multi-level BOMs supported via assembly orders
production_orders: Yes - 'Production Orders' module with assembly orders (build finished good from components) and disassembly orders (break finished good into components); BOM stock levels can only be updated via Production Orders
batch_lot_tracking: Yes - batch/lot number tracking with expiry dates; designed for food, cosmetics, pharma and other shelf-life industries; supports recall traceability from raw material to finished good and customer
serial_tracking: Yes - serial number tracking supported alongside batch/lot
bin_location_support: [uncertain] - multi-warehouse confirmed; explicit bin/aisle/sub-location tracking inside a warehouse not clearly documented
multi_warehouse: Yes - multi-warehouse with inventory transfers between locations; lower tiers cap warehouse count (e.g. 2 on Starter), unlimited on higher tiers
barcoding: Yes - barcode capture on product records; compatible with standard barcode scanners; mobile app uses phone camera as scanner
purchase_orders: Full PO module (V2) with partial receipts, supplier price tracking, landed cost capture, auto-sync to Xero/QBO as Bills on approval
supplier_management: Supplier records, supplier price tracking, supplier SKU codes; lead times and MOQs [uncertain - explicit field support]
landed_cost_support: Yes - two methods: 'basic' (capture extra cost items on the same invoice) and 'advanced' (allocate freight/duty/insurance across one or more POs with detailed cost capture); included in moving-average inventory valuation
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: [uncertain] - platform is multi-currency for sales/purchases (200 currencies, price lists per currency) but per-currency inventory valuation vs single base currency not explicitly documented
ai_demand_forecasting: [uncertain] - forecasting referenced in marketing copy ('forecasting') but AI/ML-specific demand forecasting not clearly documented
public_api: Yes - public Developer API documented at qoblex.com/api with REST endpoints for custom integrations; $20/month add-on for API access
webhook_event_coverage: [uncertain] - public webhook event catalog not enumerated in public sources
integration_architecture: Native - direct integrations to Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, Xero, QuickBooks Online built and maintained by Qoblex; public API for custom/iPaaS extensions
zapier_make_support: [uncertain] - no documented official Zapier/Make/n8n connector; custom integrations achievable via public API
mobile_app: Yes - native iOS (iPhone/iPad) and Android app for order entry, product catalog browsing, sales creation, pick/pack/dispatch, payment processing, reporting
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes - mobile app uses phone camera as barcode scanner to find products and create sales/adjustments; no extra hardware required
rate_limit_handling_documented: [uncertain] - public documentation of throttle handling for Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO not located
sync_frequency: Xero/QBO: ~5_min plus event-triggered on order changes. Shopify/WooCommerce: near real-time / 5-minute polling with event triggers. Amazon: [uncertain]
shipping_carrier_integrations: [uncertain] - no direct in-app shipping carrier (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS/AusPost) integrations clearly documented; fulfillment workflow exists but label-buying appears to rely on external systems or marketplace fulfillment
three_pl_integrations: [uncertain] - integrations with 'fulfillment systems' mentioned generally but specific 3PL connectors (ShipBob, ShipHero, Extensiv) not documented
g2_rating: [uncertain] - no prominent G2 listing found for Qoblex
capterra_rating: Listed on Capterra (Stock&Buy / Qoblex profile, id 149202); positive reviews noting responsive support and Shopify bundle sync; specific overall star rating [uncertain]
notable_customers: Home Lab case study published on qoblex.com/case-studies/home-lab/; broader customer list [uncertain]
